presets.name: AMADA punch
presets.description: AMADA punch, based on FANUC with AMADA's own codes (Pavel 2026-10-12): T = tool + punching, X / Y alone = a hit, G70 = move without a hit, G72 = pattern origin, G98 = reference point, C = tool angle; patterns G26 / G28 / G29 / G36 / G66 / G67 / G68 / G69 / G78 / G79 from AMADA's AMNC-F programming manual and the Metalix AMADA customization guide. Verified on PART-IS-DOWN.nc (cncKad) and the Romstar Vipros 255 .VNC files. Tool shapes: Tools page (Fill tools from NC).

presets.name: FANUC
presets.description: FANUC-style G-code base: G00 / G01 / G02 / G03, G90 / G91, G52 local origin, O numbers + M98 P calls + M99, M30. The start for a machine without its own preset — teach its process commands (laser / punch on, tools) in the rows.

presets.name: MAZAK laser
presets.description: MAZAK laser, FANUC-style program (O numbers, M98 P call, M99 return, G52 local origin per part). Technology routines as sub-program calls: M98P5001 laser on, M98P5900 laser off, M98P6004 cutting technology (Pavel 2026-10-12, Part1001orig.YNC); M23 = sensor off (Pavel). Verified on Part1001orig.YNC / Part1001.YNC. Other M-codes of this machine: teach them (they stay red).

presets.name: PRIMA laser
presets.description: Prima Power laser ISO (PPR Maestro): the parts as numbered bodies "N10(* …)" called with Q10 at the head position, M02 = end of a body, $(WORK_ON) / $(WORK_OFF) = process on / off, the sheet from the <material …> line. Verified on 20260325PJC_SH2.ISO.

presets.name: TRUMPF 840D LST
presets.description: TRUMPF TruTops LST for Siemens 840D (punch, laser, combi). Program structure: BEGIN_PROGRAMM list - HP = main, UP = sub-programs called by their name, GEO skipped; sheet from SHEET_TECH, tool shapes from WZG_STAMM. Verified on EC_T12_60120.LST (punch, inch), AG01338.LST (punch, GEO), SRS125ISR.LST (laser, ROT RPL). Source: docs/knowledge/ncsim-presets/trumpf-lst.md (Pavel 2026-10-12 + the files) and the Metalix TRUMPF customization guide.
